notes: The device-declaration envelope (spec 0111). Dataset keys come from dataset.json's wire entries; this file names the frame, group, source and control keys, which are the project file's own keys spelled as Keys:: constant names. It defines no new property.
scripts/generate-property-registry.py turns this file and dataset.json into DeclarationVocabulary.h and the three firmware vocabularies; scripts/registry-verify.py checks every name resolves.
Never on the wire: code (painter, transforms, parser scripts, transmit functions), file paths, URLs and connection settings.
